attribute.name.goetied.spell_duration.de: Increases the duration of Goetied spells.
attribute.name.goetied.spell_range.desc: Increases the range of Goetied spells or how far the spell can detect a target.
attribute.name.goetied.spell_burning.des: Makes certain Goetied spells burn mobs or increase duration of fire.
attribute.name.goetied.spell_velocity.de: Increases the speed and velocity of magic projectiles.
attribute.name.goetied.casting_speed.des: Reduces time needed to cast a Goetied spell.
attribute.name.goetied.soul_discount.des: Reduces the amount of soul energy needed to cast a Goetied spell.
attribute.name.goetied.abyss_potency.des: Increases the power of Goetied Abyss spells.

Increases the power of Goetied Geomancy spells.
attribute.name.goetied.necromancy_potenc: Increases the power of Goetied Necromancy spells.
attribute.name.goetied.nether_potency.de: Increases the power of Goetied Nether spells.
attribute.name.goetied.storm_potency.des: Increases the power of Goetied Storm spells.
attribute.name.goetied.void_potency.desc: Increases the power of Goetied Void spells.
attribute.name.goetied.wild_potency.desc: Increases the power of Goetied Wild spells.
attribute.name.goetied.wind_potency.desc: Increases the power of Goetied Wind spells.
item.goetied.zpiglin_brute_servant_spawn: Zombified Piglin Brute Servant Spawn Egg
item.goetied.focus.info: When Cast in Wand or Staff:
item.goetied.vexing_focus.info: Summons allied Vexes. Cast crouching will kill all the caster's Vexes.
item.goetied.biting_focus.info: Summons a row of magic Fangs in front of caster. Cast crouching will summon Fangs around the caster.
item.goetied.rotting_focus.info: Summons Zombie Servants. Cast crouching will summon the caster's servants towards them.
item.goetied.osseous_focus.info: Summons Skeleton Servants. Cast crouching will summon the caster's servants towards them.
item.goetied.reaping_focus.info: Summons Reaper Servants. Cast crouching will summon the caster's servants towards them.
item.goetied.ghost_fire_focus.info: Summons Ice Bouquets beneath a target or at a location.
item.goetied.spooky_focus.info: Summons Wraith Servants. Cast crouching will summon the caster's servants towards them.
item.goetied.phantasm_focus.info: Summons Phantom Servants. Cast crouching will summon the caster's servants towards them.
item.goetied.vanguard_focus.info: Summons Vanguard Servants. Cast crouching will summon the caster's servants towards them.
item.goetied.blackguard_focus.info: Summons Blackguard Servants. Cast crouching will summon the caster's servants towards them.
item.goetied.leeching_focus.info: Siphons health from a target in front of the caster.
item.goetied.killing_focus.info: Shoots a bolt at a target that deals their current health amount of damage, but also deal 125% of it towards the caster. If this would kill the caster, deals less amount of damage.
item.goetied.skull_focus.info: Summons Haunted Skulls. Cast crouching will summon the caster's skulls towards them.
item.goetied.wither_skull_focus.info: Shoots a Wither Skull in front of the caster. Cast crouching will shoot a blue skull that's slower but more destructive.
item.goetied.ghastly_focus.info: Summons Mini-Ghasts. Cast crouching will dismiss all allied Mini-Ghasts.
item.goetied.blazing_focus.info: Summons Blaze Servants. Cast crouching will summon the caster's servants towards them.
item.goetied.iceology_focus.info: Summons an Ice Chunk above a location or non-allied target. Ice Chunk will fall after a time stunning and slowing entities below it.
item.goetied.frost_nova_focus.info: Summons a non-destructive frost explosion on the caster, or on a target if crouch casting, knocking back and freezing nearby non-allied targets.
item.goetied.frostborn_focus.info: Summons an Ice Golem. Cast crouching will summon the caster's servants towards them.
item.goetied.barricade_focus.info: Summons Totemic Walls at a location or surrounding a target. Cast crouching will summon Totemic Bombs, that will explode after a time.
item.goetied.quaking_focus.info: Sends tremors in front of the caster, damaging and flinging non-allied entities. Cast crouching will summon tremors around the caster.
item.goetied.earth_punch_focus.info: Summons a fist made of stone from below a target or at a location.
item.goetied.pulverize_focus.info: Transforms certain blocks into another when right-clicked on them, ie. Cobblestone to Gravel.
item.goetied.rotation_focus.info: Right-clicking on certain block rotates its orientation or direction.
item.goetied.burrowing_focus.info: Shoots a mining laser that mines blocks.
item.goetied.sensing_focus.info: Gives Tremor Sense effect, which causes the caster to be able to detect creatures behind walls if both are touching the ground.
item.goetied.scatter_focus.info: Summons Scatter Mines around the caster, that will let out a non-destructive explosion if a non-allied target enters its area.
item.goetied.eruption_focus.info: Summons a small volcano at a location which will shoot several flaming rocks at the sky.
item.goetied.illusion_focus.info: Summons Doppelgangers of the caster. Cast crouching will dismiss all allied Dopplegangers.
item.goetied.feast_focus.info: Summons a magic Fang on any nearby mob or player that's not the caster.
item.goetied.teeth_focus.info: Summons a magic Tooth above a location or non-allied target. After a time, it will fall towards the ground, damaging and flinging targets below.
item.goetied.shredding_focus.info: Summons a row of royal Spikes in front of caster. Damages any non-allied targets caught in them.
item.goetied.ignite_focus.info: Sets a target or block on fire on touch.
item.goetied.fire_breath_focus.info: Shoots a torrent of soul fire in front of them, burning non-allied and non fire-immune targets.
item.goetied.fireball_focus.info: Shoots a small Fireball that damages non fire-immune targets.
item.goetied.lavaball_focus.info: Shoots a Lava Bomb. Cast crouching will make the Lava Bomb non-destructive on terrain.
item.goetied.bombardment_focus.info: Shoots several small Fireballs after quick successions. Causes caster to slowly float off the ground.
item.goetied.meteor_shower_focus.info: Shoots lava bombs towards an area or target the caster's looking at.
item.goetied.magma_bomb_focus.info: Shoots a Magma Bomb, which will explode and summon several loyal Magma Cubes.
item.goetied.fire_blast_focus.info: Summons a non-destructive fiery explosion on the caster, knocking back, burning and damaging nearby non-allied targets.
item.goetied.flame_strike_focus.info: Summons Fire Pillars around the caster. Looking at a valid target and not crouching will surround them with Fire Pillars instead.
item.goetied.soul_bolt_focus.info: Shoots a Soul Bolt that deals small magic damage and high knockback.
item.goetied.magic_bolt_focus.info: Shoots a Magic Bolt that deals small magic damage and summons a small pool of damaging magic on a target that's hit by it.
item.goetied.sword_focus.info: Shoots a magical duplicate of the caster's sword. Does nothing if caster is not wielding a sword off or main hand.
item.goetied.frost_breath_focus.info: Shoots a torrent of frost in front of them, giving non-allied targets freezing damage.
item.goetied.ice_spike_focus.info: Shoots an Ice Spike. Ice Spikes deals small freezing damage and gives target Freezing for a short time.
item.goetied.ice_storm_focus.info: Shoots an Ice Storm that damages targets within its radius with freezing damage and gives Freezing for a short time. Can pass through blocks but moves slowly.
item.goetied.hail_focus.info: Summons a cloud above a location or target that causes any non-allied targets beneath it to take freezing damage.
item.goetied.blizzard_focus.info: Shoots spikes of ice towards an area or target the caster's looking at.
item.goetied.chilling_focus.info: Gives Chill Hide effect to caster, or an allied target while crouch casting, which increases armor points and cause attackers to get Freezing effect.
item.goetied.updraft_focus.info: Summons a cloud of wind on a location or target that, after a time, shoots any target up in the air, damaging them.
item.goetied.wind_blast_focus.info: Shoots a blast of wind that deals no damage to targets, but will knock them back.
item.goetied.razor_wind_focus.info: Shoots a powerful slash of wind in front of the caster.
item.goetied.trembling_focus.info: Pushes non-allied entities away from the caster and slows them briefly.
item.goetied.swarm_focus.info: Shoots a torrent of insects in front of the caster. Upon death, an Insect Swarm will spawn on the target's position for a time.
item.goetied.poison_dart_focus.info: Shoots a Poison dart, which deals small damage and gives target Poison for a short time.
item.goetied.blossoming_focus.info: Shoots a blossom ball that, when hit, summons spiky thorns around the area of impact that damages and poisons nearby targets.
item.goetied.grapple_focus.info: Shoots a vine hook that, when latched to a block, pulls the caster towards it.
item.goetied.hunting_focus.info: Summons Black Wolves. Cast crouching will summon the caster's servants towards them.
item.goetied.mauling_focus.info: Summons a Bear Servant. Cast crouching will summon the caster's servants towards them.
item.goetied.slimy_focus.info: Summons Slime Servants. Cast crouching will summon the caster's servants towards them.
item.goetied.carrion_focus.info: Summon a swarm of Carrion Flies. Cast crouching will summon the caster's servants towards them.
item.goetied.overgrowth_focus.info: Summons Quick Growing Vines at a location or surrounding a target. Cast crouching will summon a Poison-Quill Vine, that shoots poison quills at enemies.
item.goetied.entangling_focus.info: Summons Entangle Vines on a target's feet or location. If the vines caught a target, they are immobilized in place.
item.goetied.whispering_focus.info: Summons Whisperers. Cast crouching will summon the caster's servants towards them.
item.goetied.leaping_focus.info: Summons Leapleaves. Cast crouching will summon the caster's servants towards them.
item.goetied.shocking_focus.info: Shoots multiple electric currents at a non-allied target.
item.goetied.charge_focus.info: Right-clicking on a mob or player will give them Charged and increase their Charged level. Charged I boosts Speed and Damage a bit, Charged II boosts Speed a lot but lowers Damage, giving another level will damage them.
item.goetied.thunderbolt_focus.info: Shoots a large electric bolt at a non-allied target
item.goetied.electrocute_focus.info: Shoots an electrical orb that, when looking at a target, follows them until it hits an object.
item.goetied.monsoon_focus.info: Summons a cloud above a location or target that rains on targets beneath it and periodically shoots thunderbolts at them.
item.goetied.discharge_focus.info: Summons a non-destructive electrical explosion on the caster, knocking back and damaging nearby non-allied targets.
item.goetied.bolting_focus.info: Covers caster with electricity and launch them towards the direction they're looking at, knocking back and damaging nearby non-allied targets.
item.goetied.lightning_focus.info: Summons a Lightning Bolt at a location or target.
item.goetied.thunderstorm_focus.info: Summons multiple thunderbolts around the caster or target.
item.goetied.bubble_stream_focus.info: Shoots a torrent of bubbles in front of the caster. Targets take water-based damage but also gain oxygen.
item.goetied.bouncy_bubble_focus.info: Shoots a giant bubble that bounces off surfaces and targets.
item.goetied.steaming_focus.info: Shoots a barrage of Steam Missiles that damages and knocks back targets.
item.goetied.trident_storm_focus.info: Summons tridents falling from the sky around the caster that will deal lightning damage towards targets within the area of effect once they hit the ground.
item.goetied.prisma_beam_focus.info: Shoots a beam towards a valid target the caster is looking at where it will deal damage after a short amount of time. Caster must consistently look at the target before spell ends.
item.goetied.guardian_focus.info: Summons a Guardian Servant. Cast crouching will summon the caster's servants towards them.
item.goetied.biomine_focus.info: Summons Biomines around caster or valid target that will explode into a pool of acid.
item.goetied.water_whip_focus.info: Summons a short-range tentacle that pierces through targets in front of the caster.
item.goetied.tidal_focus.info: Summons waves of rushing water in front of the caster, pushing away and damaging non-allied targets.
item.goetied.shockwave_focus.info: Summons a non-destructive soul explosion on the caster, knocking back and damaging nearby non-allied targets.
item.goetied.sonic_boom_focus.info: Shoots a Sonic Boom in front of them. Sonic Booms deals damage that goes through armor and enchantments.
item.goetied.end_walk_focus.info: Renders caster completely invisible. Once effect ends or break, the caster teleports back to where the spell was cast.
item.goetied.blink_focus.info: Teleports the caster to a location, or around a mob, they're looking at from a certain range. Crouch casting will cause the caster to teleport to a random location.
item.goetied.banish_focus.info: Right-clicking on a mob or player will teleport them away from the caster.
item.goetied.tunnel_focus.info: Summons an ethereal tunnel for a short while after right-clicking on a block, allowing entities to walk or fall through.
item.goetied.rupture_focus.info: Summons a Void Rift at the initial location the caster is looking at. The rift will suck in non-allied entities and constantly damage them if they're within its center.
item.goetied.stellar_focus.info: Summons Void Shocks that will home onto any valid targets position, unleashing a void explosion that damages nearby non-allied entities.
item.goetied.void_flash_focus.info: Shoots a Void Shock Bomb that will explode upon impact and shoots out several Void Shocks.
item.goetied.watching_focus.info: Summons Watchling Servants. Cast crouching will summon the caster's servants towards them.
item.goetied.blasting_focus.info: Summons Blastling Servants. Cast crouching will summon the caster's servants towards them.
item.goetied.snaring_focus.info: Summons Snareling Servants. Cast crouching will summon the caster's servants towards them.
item.goetied.soul_light_focus.info: Shoots a projectile that will create a dim ball of light when hit on a location.
item.goetied.glow_light_focus.info: Shoots a projectile that will create a glowing ball of light when hit on a location.
item.goetied.illuminate_focus.info: Creates glowing balls of light in unlit areas and replaces soul lights around the caster.
item.goetied.iron_hide_focus.info: Gives Iron Hide effect which increases caster's armor points.
item.goetied.bulwark_focus.info: Gives magical shields that surrounds the caster. Taking damage from a mob or player will destroy a shield and knocks back the attacker.
item.goetied.soul_heal_focus.info: Heals the caster from a range of an amount.
item.goetied.weakening_focus.info: Weakens non-allied targets in a large area around the caster, decreasing their attack damage and have them take more incoming damage.
item.goetied.arrow_rain_focus.info: Shoots arrows towards an area or target the caster's looking at.
item.goetied.telekinesis_focus.info: Targets an entity to float around the caster's crosshair.
item.goetied.launch_focus.info: Launches the caster to the direction they're looking at.
item.goetied.flying_focus.info: Fly at the direction the caster is looking at.
item.goetied.cushion_focus.info: Summons a cloud on a location which will cause any entity that falls on it to not take fall damage.
item.goetied.whirlwind_focus.info: Surrounds the caster in a whirlwind, which deflects nearby entities and slowly raise the caster up.
item.goetied.cyclone_focus.info: Shoots a Cyclone that will cause any non-allied targets caught in it to be stuck and thrown.
item.goetied.call_focus.info: Left-clicking on a servant will save it to the focus. If the focus has a servant saved on it, teleports the servant towards the caster.
item.goetied.troop_focus.info: Left-clicking on a servant will save it's type to the focus. If the focus has servant type saved on it, teleports the all servants of that type towards the caster.
item.goetied.recall_focus.info: Right-clicking on certain blocks will save its position to the focus. If the focus has a position saved on it, teleports the caster or, if directly right-clicked on, the servant to the position.
item.goetied.command_focus.info: Left-clicking on a servant will save it to the focus. If the focus has a servant saved on it, right-clicking on a block or entity will make the servant move to its position, right-clicking on a certain mob will cause the servant to attempt to ride on it.
item.goetied.order_focus.info: Left-clicking on a servant will save it to the focus. Can save up to 8 servants. If the focus has servants saved on it, right-clicking on a block or entity will make all stored servants move to its position, right-clicking on a certain mob will cause servants to attempt to ride on it.
item.goetied.ender_chest_focus.info: Opens the caster's Ender Chest on their location.
item.goetied.crafting_focus.info: Opens up a Crafting Table menu.
item.goetied.corruption_focus.info: Shoots out a beam of corruption that deals constant magic damage and ignores invulnerability frames.
effect.goetied.summon_down.description: Spells cost more Soul Energy to cast, higher levels increases cost. Newly summoned Mobs will gain Sapped and Weakness.
effect.goetied.sapped.description: Increases damage taken by 20% per level.
effect.goetied.gold_touched.description: Mobs drop gold nuggets on death, with amount increasing on higher levels.
effect.goetied.burn_hex.description: Removes Fire Resistance from living entities. On Hard, fire damage doubles.
effect.goetied.soul_hunger.description: Weakens movement, mining and attack speed and melee damage.
effect.goetied.buff.description: Increases melee attack damage by 0.5 hearts per level.
effect.goetied.rampage.description: Increases melee attack damage by 0.5 heart per level, Increases mining and attack speed. Spawns an explosion after gaining 5 levels.
effect.goetied.climbing.description: Grants ability to climb up horizontal walls and move through Cobwebs.
effect.goetied.busted.description: Reduces armor points by 50% per level.
effect.goetied.soul_armor.description: Increases armor points by 2. Triples armor points if affected entities does not wear any armor.
effect.goetied.iron_hide.description: Increases armor points by 4 per level.
effect.goetied.chill_hide.description: Increases armor points by 3 per level. Entities attacking the affected gets Freezing effect.
effect.goetied.pressure.description: Periodically damages the affected when surrounded by multiple entities.
effect.goetied.charged.description: Level I gives 10% boost to speed and melee damage, Level II gives 25% boost to speed and reduction in melee damage. Gaining another Level will give damage.
effect.goetied.ender_ground.description: Prevents teleportation unless it's by chat command.
effect.goetied.ender_flux.description: Teleports the affected to a random location when damaged; higher levels increases the distance.
effect.goetied.freezing.description: Simulate being in powdered snow. Does nothing if immune to freezing.
effect.goetied.nyctophobia.description: Periodically deals damage when in dark areas.
effect.goetied.sun_allergy.description: Sets the affected entities on fire and damages helmet when in daylight.
effect.goetied.snow_skin.description: Gives characteristics of Snow Golems to affected entities.
effect.goetied.evil_eye.description: Causes monsters to periodically spawn around the affected.
effect.goetied.tripping.description: Causes the affected entities to be pushed in random direction periodically, higher levels makes it more frequent.
effect.goetied.arrowmantic.description: Attract arrows towards the affected entities. Higher levels increases the radius.
effect.goetied.sense_loss.description: Gives players blindness and causes mobs to have lower visibility range, with higher levels lowering it further.
effect.goetied.flame_hands.description: Physical attacks sets entities aflame for 4 seconds with each level increasing the duration.
effect.goetied.venomous_hands.descriptio: Physical attacks gives Poison for 10 seconds with each level increasing the level.
effect.goetied.repulsive.description: Knocks back attacking entity away; higher levels increases knockback distance.
effect.goetied.explosive.description: Have a chance of unleashing an explosion when hurt; higher levels increases chance and explosion strength.
effect.goetied.frog_leg.description: Allows double jumping; higher levels increases number of jumps.
effect.goetied.insight.description: Doubles the amount of experience points dropped; higher levels increases yield.
effect.goetied.bottling.description: Increases the amount of brews bottled from Witch's Cauldron.
effect.goetied.fire_trail.description: Walking sets the ground beneath on fire.
effect.goetied.fiery_aura.description: Sets nearby entities on fire; higher levels increases range and burn duration.
effect.goetied.frosty_aura.description: Gives nearby entities Freezing; higher levels increases range and Freezing level.
effect.goetied.plunge.description: Causes flying or swimming affected entities to drop towards the ground.
effect.goetied.flimsy.description: Affected entities take more knockback from attacks; higher levels increases knockback.
effect.goetied.photosynthesis.descriptio: Regenerates health when in sunlight; higher levels make health regenerate quicker.
effect.goetied.flammable.description: Affected entities take more damage from fire; does not effect fire resistant entities.
effect.goetied.storms_wrath.description: Randomly struck the affected with lightning when exposed to the sky; higher levels and rain makes it likelier.
effect.goetied.save_effects.description: Effects persists after affected player's death. Does nothing if player is in hardcore.
effect.goetied.wild_rage.description: Affected entities will target and attack any nearby attackable entities.
effect.goetied.stunned.description: Stops affected from doing anything like moving, attacking or using blocks or items.
effect.goetied.shadow_walk.description: Grants true invisibility. Removed when interacting with blocks, entities or items. Multiplies attack damage while under the effect.
effect.goetied.doom.description: Once effect expires, deals instant death if affected is on low health. Bosses cannot be effected.
effect.goetied.fortunate.description: Increases Fortune level for affected. Increases by effect level.
effect.goetied.corpse_eater.description: Restores hunger and saturation with each kill.
effect.goetied.acid_venom.description: Inflicts non lethal damage over time; higher levels do more damage per second. Does affect Undead
effect.goetied.spasms.description: Inflicts non lethal damage over time, pushing affected in random direction when inflicted; higher levels do more damage per second.
effect.goetied.electrified.description: Shoots out an bolt from the affected at two random nearby non-allied entities; higher levels deals more damage.
effect.goetied.altruistic.description: Receiving incoming damage heals nearby allied entities; higher levels increases healing amount.
effect.goetied.radiance.description: Attacking entities in melee has a 20% chance of healing affected and nearby allied entities; higher levels increases healing amount.
effect.goetied.deflective.description: Chance of deflecting incoming arrows from affected, negating damage; higher levels increases the chance.
effect.goetied.leeching.description: Heals affected per attack, healing 5% of target's max health; higher levels increases amount healed.
effect.goetied.swirling.description: Physical attacks causes swirling attack that damages nearby non-allied entities; higher levels deals more damage.
effect.goetied.shielding.description: Adds damage resistance to affected and their nearby allies; higher levels increases damage reduction.
effect.goetied.shielded.description: Adds damage resistance to affected; higher levels increases damage reduction.
effect.goetied.rallying.description: Increases attack damage of affected and their nearby allies by 10%%; higher levels increases damage by 10%%.
effect.goetied.rallied.description: Increases attack damage of affected by 10%%; higher levels increases damage by 10%%.
effect.goetied.gravity_pulse.description: Pulls nearby non-allied entities to affected every 3 seconds; higher levels increases radius of effect.
effect.goetied.tremor_sense.description: Causes entities to glow towards the affected, but only if both are touching the ground; higher levels increase glowing radius.
effect.goetied.impaired.description: Prevents breaking or placing blocks; does not affect creative players.
effect.goetied.crippled.description: Massively reduces affected's movement speed, attack speed and attack damage; removes itself once affected has been healed greatly.
effect.goetied.void_touched.description: Doubles incoming damage per level; removes itself once affected takes damage.
enchantment.goetied.soul_eater.desc: Increases the amount of Soul Energy gained after killing a mob.
enchantment.goetied.wanting.desc: Mobs will drop more loot when killed via Summoned Creatures/Spells.
enchantment.goetied.range.desc: Increases the range of Spells or how far the Spell can detect a target.
enchantment.goetied.burning.desc: Makes Spells burn mobs or increase duration of fire.
enchantment.goetied.absorb.desc: Causes the player to heal when Spells damages mob.
enchantment.goetied.magnet.desc: Causes blocks dropped by spells to automatically go into inventory.
enchantment.goetied.velocity.desc: Increases the speed and velocity of magic projectiles.
info.goetied.wand.switch: Press %d while holding to switch focus
info.goetied.items.dark_scroll.desc: Must be used within a Woodland Mansion.
info.goetied.items.dark_scroll.failure: You are not within a Woodland Mansion!
info.goetied.items.blaze_horn.desc: Must be used within a Nether Fortress.
info.goetied.items.blaze_horn.failure: You are not within a Nether Fortress!
info.goetied.items.warred: The template for ancient war machines.
info.goetied.items.buried: Some sort of ancient manuscript of a nameless kingdom...
info.goetied.items.front: A repurposed spell of a nameless king...
info.goetied.items.floral: Old rites for whispering to the flora.
info.goetied.items.terminus: The schematics of a terrifying monstrosity...
info.goetied.research.ravaging: You have learned the method of creating Ravagers!
info.goetied.research.warred: You have learned the method of making Redstone Golems!
info.goetied.research.buried: You have learned the nameless paths of Necromancy!
info.goetied.research.haunting: You have learned the method of possessing Armors!
info.goetied.research.front: You have learned the method of summoning Vanguards!
info.goetied.research.mistral: You have learned the method of constructing Squall Golems!
info.goetied.research.floral: You have learned the method of creating Whisperers and Leapleaves!
info.goetied.research.bygone: You have learned the forgotten arts of the Nether!
info.goetied.research.terminus: You have learned the method of constructing Monstrosities!
info.goetied.research.forbidden: You have learned the secret to Immortality!
info.goetied.dark_hat: Halves casting time for all spells.
info.goetied.grand_turban: Have a chance of spawning an allied Irk when taking damage.
info.goetied.frost_crown_cast: Halves casting time for frost spells.
info.goetied.wild_crown_cast: Halves casting time for wild spells.
info.goetied.abyss_crown_cast: Halves casting time for abyss spells.
info.goetied.void_crown_cast: Halves casting time for void spells.
info.goetied.nether_crown_cast: Halves casting time for nether spells.
info.goetied.witch_hat: Speeds up witches robes inner brewing stand. Slowly grants fuel in moonlight
info.goetied.witch_hat_potion: 10% chance of not consuming a Potion after drinking.
info.goetied.crone_hat_potion: 25% chance of not consuming a Potion after drinking. 10% if it's a Brew.
info.goetied.necro_crown_cast: Halves casting time for necromancy spells.
info.goetied.necro_crown_weakness: Gives Weakness when worn in sunlight.
